$comment: Configuration profile (robot-capability-specs v2.0.2). Every value is MuJoCo Playground's play_t1_joystick.py / t1_mjx_feetonly.xml at the pinned commit; tests check them against the pinned upstream files. Nothing is tuned.
name: playground
summary: Google DeepMind MuJoCo Playground's T1 joystick policy (experimental/sim2sim/onnx/t1_policy.onnx) on Playground's own T1 MJCF <position> actuators, with the observation, default pose (keyframe home) and rates of play_t1_joystick.py.

nominal_base_height.ref: task profile:stand:playground (play_t1_joystick.py loop, zero command, 10 s: trunk 0.667 m)

fall_base_height.reason: About two-thirds of the standing trunk height, the rule used for stock and the G1.

settings.scene_note: play_t1_joystick.py loads the rough-terrain scene (heightfield floor, keyframe z 0.72). The hallway floor is flat, so this configuration uses Playground's flat-terrain scene of the same robot MJCF (plane floor, keyframe home z 0.665), as the G1 playground configuration does. The robot MJCF, actuators and gains are unchanged.
settings.command_note: play_t1_joystick.py's vel_scale_x/y/rot (1, 0.8, 1) only scale gamepad input; the runner passes the command directly. Its phase is pi for |command| < 0.01; only non-zero commands are run.
settings.actuation: position: the MJCF's own <position> actuators (kp from its default classes, joint damping/armature as published); ctrl = action * 1.0 + keyframe home qpos[7:], once per 10 physics steps, first in physics step 9
